The goal is simple: use their existing WhatsApp Business phone number to open a brand-new WhatsApp Business account that will be dedicated to customer support and reply-based conversations. You’ll walk me through the Meta registration steps (or handle them directly if I grant temporary access), confirm the phone number without interrupting current service, and make sure the profile, display name, and basic settings are all in place so my client can start answering customer queries immediately. Deliverables: • New WhatsApp Business account successfully created under the client’s Meta Business Manager • Existing WhatsApp Business number verified and linked • Basic profile settings (business name, description, logo) completed • Short hand-off note so my client knows exactly where to find everything and how to begin replying to customers It’s a straightforward job that should be quick for anyone familiar with Meta’s current interface and the WhatsApp Business onboarding flow. I’m ready to begin as soon as you are.

opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional para el desarrollo y diseño de una página web completa para un importante negocio dedicado a la distribución de alimentos. El objetivo principal es establecer una presencia online sólida y profesional que permita a los clientes conocer la empresa, sus productos y servicios. La web debe ser intuitiva, fácil de navegar y visualmente atractiva, reflejando la calidad y seriedad del negocio. Se espera que la página incluya secciones como: información sobre la empresa, catálogo de productos (sin funcionalidad de compra directa), formulario de contacto y posiblemente una sección de noticias o blog. Es fundamental que el diseño sea responsive para una correcta visualización en diferentes dispositivos. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Bug o cambio pequeño

opportunities.title: Diseñador Gráfico para Logo Original de marca personal
opportunities.description: Se busca un diseñador gráfico talentoso para crear un logo 100% original para marca personal. La marca está dirigida a mujeres de 28 a 50 años que buscan reinventarse y renacer. El diseño debe ser elegante, estilizado, femenino y cálido, con un fénix de alas abiertas como símbolo principal, representando la idea de renacimiento. La paleta de colores deseada incluye tonos de vino, rojo, naranja y dorado. El logo debe ser versátil y funcionar eficazmente tanto en fondos claros como oscuros, y mantener su legibilidad y estética en tamaños pequeños, como un ícono de aplicación. Los entregables requeridos son: - Archivos vectoriales en formatos svg, ai y pdf. - Archivos PNG de alta resolución. - Versiones a color y en un solo color del logo. - ÍCono optimizado para redes sociales y aplicaciones. Se espera un diseño completamente original, sin el uso de plantillas ni herramientas de inteligencia artificial. El proyecto incluirá al menos 2 rondas de cambios para asegurar la satisfacción con el resultado final. Adicionalmente, se requiere la cesión de derechos de autor por escrito. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Diseño de Logo ¿Qué necesitas?: Crear un logo desde cero
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante: L. F. (Ecuador). Publicó el anuncio en Workana (Hace 1 hora) con presupuesto de Menos de USD 50.

opportunities.title: Integración Split Payments Flutter
opportunities.description: Tengo una app en Flutter ya operativa y necesito integrar un sistema de cobros con modalidad split. El flujo debe permitir que un usuario pague a otro en el acto y que, en la misma transacción, se desvíe automáticamente nuestra comisión a la cuenta de la app. Alcance • Usuarios pagarán solo en un país (Argentina), así que la pasarela puede estar enfocada en ese mercado. Si puede ser una plataforma que trabaje en países limítrofes mejor. • Quiero admitir Tarjetas de crédito débito y billeteras virtuales para maximizar la conversión. • La solución debe funcionar con pagos en tiempo real y reflejar las dos transferencias (cliente-destinatario y comisión) sin demoras. Lo que espero recibir 1. Implementación completa en Flutter (Dart) lista para producción, con manejo de errores y validaciones. 2. Configuración del proveedor de pagos elegido (por ejemplo, Stripe Connect, Mercado Pago Split o el que mejores condiciones ofrezca para mi caso). 3. Código bien documentado y guía paso a paso para desplegar en nuestros entornos. 4. Soporte para pruebas end-to-end hasta que podamos procesar la primera transacción real. Tiempo Lo necesito lo más pronto posible; indícame un plan claro con hitos y plazos reales. Si ya has integrado pagos split en Flutter y conoces los requisitos fiscales/locales del país de destino, cuéntame tu experiencia y el stack que propones. Estoy listo para empezar de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Lerma - Evaluación Presencial de Atención y Servicio -- 10
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Toluca, Metepec, Lerma o poniente de CDMX. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.

opportunities.title: Google Sheets Tab Organizer
opportunities.description: I keep a single Google Sheets file on Drive that has grown increasingly chaotic. Tabs are out of order, some contain overlapping information, and the data itself needs a tidy-up so I can locate figures quickly and run simple analyses without hunting around first. Here is what I need: reorganise the existing tabs, give them clear names, and streamline the data inside each one. That includes making sure rows and columns are consistently formatted, removing any obvious duplicates, and putting everything in a logical, readable order. If lightweight formulas, filters or a bit of Apps Script automation will make the final layout easier to maintain, feel free to incorporate them. Deliverables • My original Google Sheets file returned with all tabs reordered, renamed and cleaned • A brief change log summarising what you adjusted and any formulas or scripts you introduced Once the spreadsheet is orderly I can take it from there, so the focus is purely on structure and clarity rather than building new dashboards or reports.

opportunities.title: Live Crypto Bot Parameter Editor
opportunities.description: # C# Developer Needed – Add Live Parameter Editing to Crypto Trading Bot Project Overview I’m looking for a C# developer to add a live parameter editing feature to an existing crypto trading bot. Currently, the bot needs to be restarted whenever configuration parameters are changed. I want to be able to modify and apply parameters directly through the UI while the bot is running, without restarting it. Technical Environment - Language: C# - Framework: .NET Framework 4.7.2 - IDE: Visual Studio 2026 Scope of Work - Add a simple UI section or popup window for editing bot parameters. - Allow parameter changes to take effect immediately while the bot is running. - Ensure thread safety with the active trading logic. - Allow updated parameters to be saved to the configuration file. Note: A complete UI redesign is not required. Only a simple UI addition for parameter editing is needed. Deliverables - Updated C# source code that compiles successfully. - An approximately 3-minute demo video showing the bot running, parameters being modified through the UI, and changes taking effect immediately without restarting the bot. Preferred Qualifications - Developers who can publicly showcase their previous crypto trading bot development or modification experience through a portfolio or project examples. Budget & Deadline - Total fixed project budget: $30–$50 - Expected delivery time: 1–2 days I will provide the relevant source code files and additional project details.

opportunities.title: Mobile 3D Saddle Shim Creator
opportunities.description: I’m building an MVP that lets a rider pull out a phone, take a quick sweep of the horse’s back plus the underside of the saddle, and instantly receive a 3-D printable shim that fills any voids. The very first release must: • Guide the user through a phone-camera–only capture flow (no external scanners). • Reconstruct both surfaces, align them automatically, and calculate the gaps. • Generate a finished 3-D model of the shim—STL or OBJ—sized for printing in a recyclable foam-like material or produce the measurements to have one made without a 3d scanner. Core logic can rely on photogrammetry, ARKit/ARCore or a similar SDK; I’m happy to hear your proposal on the best stack as long as the workflow stays on a standard iOS or Android handset. Accuracy has to be good enough that a printed shim slots in without knife work; ±2 mm tolerance is the target. The deliverable is the functional mobile app (prototype is fine) plus commented source and build instructions. If you prefer to start with a Unity, Flutter or native approach, just explain why. I’ll test by scanning multiple saddle–horse combinations and printing the resulting shims, so we’ll know quickly whether the geometry holds up. If you have experience in 3-D scanning, computational geometry, or equine saddle fitting, that’s a bonus—but solid mobile computer-vision skills are the key. Let me know how you’d tackle the surface reconstruction and gap-filling algorithm and how many weeks you need for this first milestone.

raw_data.verbatim_request: "I’m building an MVP that lets a rider pull out a phone, take a quick sweep of the horse’s back plus the underside of the saddle, and instantly receive a 3-D printable shim that fills any voids. The very first release must: • Guide the user through a phone-camera–only capture flow (no external scanners). • Reconstruct both surfaces, align them automatically, and calculate the gaps. • Generate a finished 3-D model of the shim—STL or OBJ—sized for printing in a recyclable foam-like material or produce the measurements to have one made without a 3d scanner. Core logic can rely on photogrammetry, ARKit/ARCore or a similar SDK; I’m happy to hear your proposal on the best stack as long as the workflow stays on a standard iOS or Android handset. Accuracy has to be good enough that a printed shim slots in without knife work; ±2 mm tolerance is the target. The deliverable is the functional mobile app (prototype is fine) plus commented source and build instructions. If you prefer to start with a Unity, Flutter or native approach, just explain why. I’ll test by scanning multiple saddle–horse combinations and printing the resulting shims, so we’ll know quickly whether the geometry holds up. If you have experience in 3-D scanning, computational geometry, or equine saddle fitting, that’s a bonus—but solid mobile computer-vision skills are the key. Let me know how you’d tackle the surface reconstruction and gap-filling algorithm and how many weeks you need for this first milestone."

opportunities.title: Sales Lead Automation Partner
opportunities.description: I need a developer who can turn the enquiries that arrive through my website forms and live-chat widget into a fully automated, AI-powered sales follow-up sequence. Right now every submission is handled manually; I want that replaced with a workflow that captures each lead, enriches or qualifies it, personalises the first touches, and then feeds everything back into my CRM without human intervention. The stack is flexible—Zapier, Make, Python scripts, OpenAI functions, webhook integrations or native CRM APIs are all on the table—as long as the end result is reliable, transparent, and easy to tweak. Deliverables • Visual workflow/architecture map for sign-off • Production-ready automations that: – listen for new form or chat leads – draft and send the first follow-up within minutes – schedule further touches based on lead behaviour – log every interaction in the CRM • Setup and hand-off documentation with change instructions • Short Loom or live handover call showing the system working end-to-end Acceptance criteria: a new test lead receives the first personalised email within five minutes, is visible in the CRM with all fields populated, and the automation can be paused or edited by a non-technical user. If you’ve built something similar, show me a quick demo or outline your preferred toolset and timeline, and we’ll get started.

opportunities.title: Portal Inmobiliario con Tours Virtuales
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar un portal web para mi proyecto inmobiliario que combine una experiencia inmersiva con herramientas de venta y gestión de información. Yo proporcionaré los videos y los recorridos virtuales; requiero que el sitio los integre con rapidez de carga y navegación fluida tanto en desktop como en móvil. Plano interactivo – Al hacer clic en cada lote, el visitante debe ver precio, superficie y disponibilidad, fotos, video y la ficha técnica descargable. – También debe mostrarse el contacto directo del asesor asignado a ese terreno. – Quiero actualizar lotes, precios y estatus desde un panel de administración sencillo, sin depender de código. Perfiles con niveles de acceso Solo asesores externos y compradores registrados podrán ver y descargar la información técnica y legal. Cada perfil debe permitir: • Descargar fichas técnicas y documentos legales. • Guardar terrenos favoritos y comparar opciones. • Solicitar información adicional o agendar una visita (notificación por correo y en el panel). Gestión y seguridad • Registro y autenticación diferenciada para asesores y compradores, con aprobación manual opcional. • Métricas internas sobre descargas y solicitudes. • Capacidad para que yo mismo cargue nuevos videos, tours 360° y documentos en PDF. • Diseño responsivo y tiempos de carga optimizados. Entregable Portal completamente funcional alojado en mi hosting, código fuente, guía rápida para actualizar lotes y usuarios, y soporte inicial para asegurarnos de que todo quede operativo.

opportunities.title: Simple Car Tycoon Game Development
opportunities.description: I'm looking for an experienced ROBLOX developer to create a basic car-themed tycoon game. Requirements: - Game Features: - Money collectors and upgrade buttons - Rebirths, leaderboards, and player saves - Map and UI Creation Theme: - Car dealership where players run a dealership and serve customers. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in ROBLOX game development - Experience with tycoon game mechanics - Strong UI/UX design skills - Ability to deliver quality work within budget constraints Please include examples of previous ROBLOX projects and any relevant experience in your bids. I want gameplay and map to be like "Sell Lemons" where you build your garage while uipgradeing your stand. Spawn: I want a game where you sell cars. In this game there is a road in the middle where customers come up to your stand. There should be 8 stands where 8 different players can be. After the customers come up to you, they give you a bit of money. You can then use that money to buy upgrades to your stand so you get more money. I want a UI labeled “Money $” where it counts up your money. When you stand on an upgrader to make more money, you should lose the amount of money the upgrade costs. If you can afford the upgrade to make the pad green. If you can’t make it red. If you step on a green pad it will make your money go down by the cost of the upgrade but if the pad is red it wont cost any money and say in bold red text at the top of your screen, “Can’t afford this upgrade yet”. There should be a UI labeled “Shop” where once you click on it it opens a shop UI where you can spend 9 robux to get 10% of your current money 39 robux for 200% of your money 79 robux for 500% of your money. 199 robux for 1000% of your money. And 299 for 2500% of your money. Also make a Vip for 499 robux that gives you double the amount of money customers give you, and a speed modifier that you can use to change your speed in the spawn area (make it so you can go anywhere from 10% speed to 500% speed) make it so you can only buy this once. After this make another UI that is a picture of a compass that when clicked shows you where your next upgrade is and you need to click it again to disable it. Make another UI that is labeled “Garage” that has a lock on it that doesn’t let you click the UI until you have 1,000 money where the lock disappears. When you click it there should be two sides to the UI one labeled “Buy” and one labeled “Inventory". You should start out on the buy screen where you can buy 10 different cars. When you click on the car it should show you a 3d spinning model of the car with 3 bars under it labeled “Acceleration” “Max speed” and “Drift”. The first car should be cheap but have low acceleration, max speed, and high drift. However as the cars become more expensive, its acceleration, speed, and drift should get better. Also make a “Buy This Car” Ui under the model which lets you buy the car for that price. Once you buy the car it should show up in your inventory. Make a red x in the corner of the screen that lets you go out of your garage. Finally make a UI that is labeled “Runway” This UI also has a lock on it that doesn’t let you click on it until you reach 1,000 money and the lock disappears. After you click this it should teleport you to a long runway that is quite thick. When you click Runway, replace the Runway UI with a UI that is labeled “exit”. Also remove the compass ui. Also make it so you cannot change your speed with the VIP speed changer. Finally add a new UI that is labeled “Spawn Cars” that when clicked shows you your inventory with all the cars you bought. Then you can spawn your car and drive in it. Make it so that if it has high acceleration make it accelerate fast. If it has low acceleration, make it accelerate slowly. If it has a high max speed, make its max speed high, if its max speed is low make the max speed low. If it has high drift give it high drift if it has low drift give it low drift. Once you spawn your car there should be a speedometer in the top of your screen that shows you how fast you're going. In the bottom of your screen there should be a UI that only appears when you have spawned a car, label it “Despawn car” once you click it make it so that it despawns your car and removes the UI until next time you spawn your car. Once you depsawn your car, also remove the speedometer. Make it so that you can only have 1 spawned car at a time and have to despawn your car each time to spawn a new car. On the runway add fun obstacles like ramps, hills, drops, and loops. Once you click the exit ui, make it so that your car despawns and you are teleported back to your stand. After this change the exit ui back to the runway UI, remove the speedometer, remove the spawn cars ui, add back the vip speed changer ui, and add back the compass ui. These changes should be made after you click exit ui but should be reversed once you click on runway again. Cool features: Every 10 minutes make a text on the top of your screen say, “Race is starting soon” with a countdown counting down 15 seconds next to it and below it a “yes” ui and a “no” ui. Once the 15 seconds go down to 0 remove the ui. If you click no instantly remove the ui. If you click yes remove the ui and then teleport the play that clicked yes to a 100m runway. On this runway make every player that clicked yes compete in a race that's 100m long. Make it so that you are able to spawn your car there and make it so that you can’t teleport to the runway or change your speed until you make it to the end of the track. At the end of the 100m long track make a finish line. Make it so that for 20 seconds you can’t drive your car and when the 20 seconds is up make the race start. Once you reach the finish line, teleport the player to their stand and allow them to change their speed (if they bought the vip) and teleport to the runway again. If you don't make it to the end with in 30 seconds tp the player back to there stand and allow them to tp to the runway again and change their speed(if they bought vip) after everyone finishes the race, or 30 seconds are up, show a leaderboard of everyone's times who entered the race and the fastest person should be on top while the slowest is on the bottom. Make this leaderboard appear for 5 seconds before closing. Misalaniaous: Also when you click tab to open the leaderboard, there should be two columns, one where it shows everyone your money and one where it shows how many times you have won a race. I want a global leaderboard, one with the most money, one with the most time spent in the game, and one with the most race wins. At the bottom of the leaderboard there should be a 5 minute timer that resets when it gets to 0 and when it gets to 0 the leaderboard updates.make it so that you can claim a stand so that customers go up to you and give you money. Make it so that you can't upgrade any other stand just the one you claimed. Graphics: I want you to spend a lot of time on the graphics so it doesn’t feel pixaliated. Make sure that you put A LOT OF TIME INTO GRAPHICS. I don’t want it to feel like a roblox game, but more like real life. Make the graphics so high quality that each blade of grass can be individually seen. Make sure that the entire map is very 3d. Make sure that the cars look AWESOME and that not only grass is high quality, but everything is. Also make sure that the map is quite big so you can rome around. I want it to be about the size of a pirate starter from blox fruits. Don’t use that map though, just use its size for reference. Make sure to use the sell lemons map. Similar to graphics, I want the UI to look really cool and not just basic. Please make sure to do so. Optimisation: Make the graphics good but also make sure that it is optimised for 60, 120, and 240 fps. Spend a good time making sure it doesn’t lag a bunch. Stats UI: Add a UI that says stats that shows you how much playtime you have, your amount of net worth, and amount of cars.

And 299 for 2500% of your money. Also make a Vip for 499 robux that gives you double the amount of money customers give you, and a speed modifier that you can use to change your speed in the spawn area (make it so you can go anywhere from 10% speed to 500% speed) make it so you can only buy this once. When you click on the car it should show you a 3d spinning model of the car with 3 bars under it labeled “Acceleration” “Max speed” and “Drift”. The first car should be cheap but have low acceleration, max speed, and high drift. However as the cars become more expensive, its acceleration, speed, and drift should get better. Make a red x in the corner of the screen that lets you go out of your garage. On this runway make every player that clicked yes compete in a race that's 100m long. opportunities.title: Custom Hole Pattern CAD Drafting
opportunities.description: I have an existing part with a non-standard hole layout that I need redrawn precisely in AutoCAD. I’ll supply a high-resolution photo/scan of the part; from that, I need you to replicate the entire outline and every hole location, adding accurate, clearly labeled dimensions throughout. The finished drawing must: • Show the full part profile and all hole centres, diameters, and edge distances • Use standard AutoCAD layers, line-weights, and text styles so it’s production-ready • Be delivered in both DWG (native) and PDF formats If you have a sharp eye for detail and can reverse-engineer measurements from images with confidence, I’d like to work with you.

opportunities.title: B2B-Telefonakquise Österreich (Hochdeutsch): 20 % Provision je Abschluss (Freelance, remote)
opportunities.description: Du möchtest nicht telefonieren? Auch mit Weiterempfehlungen verdienst du Geld: Empfiehlst du uns eine Firma aus der Baubranche und daraus entsteht ein bezahlter Auftrag, erhältst du ebenfalls eine Provision. Space Marino sucht kommunikative Freelancer für B2B-Telefonakquise, Sales und Terminvereinbarung bei Unternehmen in Österreich. Natürlich gesprochenes Hochdeutsch ist zwingend erforderlich, österreichische Färbung ist willkommen. Wir suchen ausdrücklich Freelancer auf eigene Rechnung, keine Anstellung. Bewerbungen aus Österreich, Deutschland und der Schweiz sind willkommen. Ideal für Studierende, Berufseinsteiger und Quereinsteiger; Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. ÜBER UNS Space Marino ist ein Schweizer Studio für Visualisierungen in Schaffhausen und Zürich. Inhaber Fabian Marino ist Profi für Visualisierungen und 3D-Modelle. Er modelliert jedes Projekt aus den Plänen der Kunden in 3D und prüft jedes Bild von Hand, bis Licht, Material und Perspektive stimmen. Genau das macht das Angebot wertvoll: Die Kunden bekommen keine Standardbilder, sondern ihr eigenes Projekt mit ihren eigenen Materialien. Der Unterschied zu KI-Bildern: Will man bei einem KI-Bild etwas ändern, verändert sich jedes Mal das ganze Bild. Bei uns bleibt der Raum gleich, und die Kunden klicken sich durch die Varianten. Nur das gewählte Material wechselt, weil Fabian jedes Projekt selbst aufbaut. Mehr unter www.spacemarino.ch WAS DU ANBIETEST - Schnell: Visualisierungen innerhalb von 1 bis 2 Tagen. - Fotorealistische Innen- und Außenvisualisierungen für Innenarchitektur, Küchen, Immobilien und Neubauten. - Visualisierungen mit Herstellerdaten und Preisen. - 360-Grad-Bilder, in denen die Endkunden Materialien selbst per Klick wechseln: Fronten, Arbeitsplatten, Böden, Wände. Ohne neues Rendering für jede Variante. - 3D-Modelle, 3D-Grundrisse und IFC-Gebäudemodelle aus Plänen, Fotos oder vorhandenen 3D-Daten. - Für Makler und Bauträger: Musterwohnung zum Durchklicken schon vor dem Bau, Bemusterungshilfe, leere Wohnungen möbliert, Fassadenvarianten. - Als Einstieg ein kostenloses Probebild aus dem eigenen Projekt des Kunden. Zielkunden ist die ganze Baubranche: Küchenbauer und Küchenstudios, Tischlereien, Innenarchitekten, Innenausbauer, Bauleiter, Planungsbüros, Makler und Bauträger. AUFGABEN UND ZIEL Unternehmen in Österreich telefonisch kontaktieren, Bedarf erkennen, den Nutzen einer Visualisierung erklären und Aufträge abschließen oder qualifizierte Gespräche mit Fabian Marino vereinbaren. Ergebnisse und nächste Schritte zuverlässig dokumentieren. Ziel sind passende, bezahlte Aufträge durch ehrliche Beratung. DATEN Wir stellen dir die Daten zur Verfügung: Firmenlisten mit Telefonnummer, Website, Branche und, soweit bekannt, Ansprechpartner. Keine eigene Recherche nötig, du telefonierst die Liste ab. Die Telefonkontakte dürfen ausschließlich im Rahmen der in Österreich geltenden Regeln zur Telefonwerbung genutzt werden. VERGÜTUNG Kein Stundenlohn. Du erhältst 20 % Provision bei jedem Abschluss, sobald der Kunde den Auftrag bezahlt hat. Je nach Auftrag sind das rund 200 bis 1000 Euro pro Abschluss, im Durchschnitt rund 400 Euro. Alles Weitere besprechen wir persönlich. Die Beispiele sind keine Verdienstgarantie. PENSUM Frei einteilbar, vollständig remote. Telefoniert wird zu üblichen österreichischen Geschäftszeiten. PROFIL Du bist offen, kommunikativ, gerne am Telefon und verkaufst gerne. Natürliches Hochdeutsch, gutes Zuhören, Zuverlässigkeit und selbstständiges Arbeiten sind wichtig. Vorerfahrung in Sales oder Telefonakquise ist keine Voraussetzung. Interesse an Küchen, Bau, Innenausbau oder Design hilft. BEWERBUNG Bitte über Freelancer bewerben, kurz mit Wohnort, Verfügbarkeit und ein paar Worten zu dir. Möglichst eine 30 bis 60 Sekunden lange Sprachnachricht auf Hochdeutsch beilegen und kurz beantworten: «Ein Tischler sagt: Wir zeichnen unsere Küchen schon im Planungsprogramm. Wozu brauche ich eine Visualisierung?»

observed_data.verbatim_request: "Du möchtest nicht telefonieren? Auch mit Weiterempfehlungen verdienst du Geld: Empfiehlst du uns eine Firma aus der Baubranche und daraus entsteht ein bezahlter Auftrag, erhältst du ebenfalls eine Provision. Space Marino sucht kommunikative Freelancer für B2B-Telefonakquise, Sales und Terminvereinbarung bei Unternehmen in Deutschland. Natürlich gesprochenes Hochdeutsch ist zwingend erforderlich. Wir suchen ausdrücklich Freelancer auf eigene Rechnung, keine Anstellung. Bewerbungen aus Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sind willkommen. Ideal für Studierende, Berufseinsteiger und Quereinsteiger; Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. ÜBER UNS Space Marino ist ein Schweizer Studio für Visualisierungen in Schaffhausen und Zürich. Inhaber Fabian Marino ist Profi für Visualisierungen und 3D-Modelle. Er modelliert jedes Projekt aus den Plänen der Kunden in 3D und prüft jedes Bild von Hand, bis Licht, Material und Perspektive stimmen. Genau das macht das Angebot wertvoll: Die Kunden bekommen keine Standardbilder, sondern ihr eigenes Projekt mit ihren eigenen Materialien. Der Unterschied zu KI-Bildern: Will man bei einem KI-Bild etwas ändern, verändert sich jedes Mal das ganze Bild. Bei uns bleibt der Raum gleich, und die Kunden klicken sich durch die Varianten. Nur das gewählte Material wechselt, weil Fabian jedes Projekt selbst aufbaut. Mehr unter www.spacemarino.ch WAS DU ANBIETEST - Schnell: Visualisierungen innerhalb von 1 bis 2 Tagen. - Fotorealistische Innen- und Außenvisualisierungen für Innenarchitektur, Küchen, Immobilien und Neubauten. - Visualisierungen mit Herstellerdaten und Preisen. - 360-Grad-Bilder, in denen die Endkunden Materialien selbst per Klick wechseln: Fronten, Arbeitsplatten, Böden, Wände. Ohne neues Rendering für jede Variante. - 3D-Modelle, 3D-Grundrisse und IFC-Gebäudemodelle aus Plänen, Fotos oder vorhandenen 3D-Daten. - Für Makler und Bauträger: Musterwohnung zum Durchklicken schon vor dem Bau, Bemusterungshilfe, leere Wohnungen möbliert, Fassadenvarianten. - Als Einstieg ein kostenloses Probebild aus dem eigenen Projekt des Kunden. Zielkunden ist die ganze Baubranche: Küchenbauer und Küchenstudios, Tischlereien und Schreinereien, Innenarchitekten, Innenausbauer, Bauleiter, Planungsbüros, Makler und Bauträger. AUFGABEN UND ZIEL Unternehmen in Deutschland telefonisch kontaktieren, Bedarf erkennen, den Nutzen einer Visualisierung erklären und Aufträge abschließen oder qualifizierte Gespräche mit Fabian Marino vereinbaren. Ergebnisse und nächste Schritte zuverlässig dokumentieren. Ziel sind passende, bezahlte Aufträge durch ehrliche Beratung. DATEN Wir stellen dir die Daten zur Verfügung: Firmenlisten mit Telefonnummer, Website, Branche und, soweit bekannt, Ansprechpartner. Keine eigene Recherche nötig, du telefonierst die Liste ab. Die Telefonkontakte dürfen ausschließlich im Rahmen der in Deutschland geltenden Regeln zur Telefonwerbung genutzt werden. VERGÜTUNG Kein Stundenlohn. Du erhältst 20 % Provision bei jedem Abschluss, sobald der Kunde den Auftrag bezahlt hat. Je nach Auftrag sind das rund 200 bis 1000 Euro pro Abschluss, im Durchschnitt rund 400 Euro. Alles Weitere besprechen wir persönlich. Die Beispiele sind keine Verdienstgarantie. PENSUM Frei einteilbar, vollständig remote. Telefoniert wird zu üblichen deutschen Geschäftszeiten. PROFIL Du bist offen, kommunikativ, gerne am Telefon und verkaufst gerne. Natürliches Hochdeutsch, gutes Zuhören, Zuverlässigkeit und selbstständiges Arbeiten sind wichtig. Vorerfahrung in Sales oder Telefonakquise ist keine Voraussetzung. Interesse an Küchen, Bau, Innenausbau oder Design hilft. BEWERBUNG Bitte über Freelancer bewerben, kurz mit Wohnort, Verfügbarkeit und ein paar Worten zu dir. Möglichst eine 30 bis 60 Sekunden lange Sprachnachricht auf Hochdeutsch beilegen und kurz beantworten: «Ein Küchenstudio sagt: Wir zeichnen unsere Küchen schon im Planungsprogramm. Wozu brauche ich eine Visualisierung?»"

proposal.body:

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, café especial borbón rosado, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

If you already have part of this database, note how recently it was refreshed.

opportunities.title: Bilingual Web Studio Appointment Setter
opportunities.description: I run a small web-design studio that wins new clients by offering a free homepage mock-up up front. Your job is to get salon, barbershop, spa, restaurant and boutique owners on a quick discovery call with me. Here is how the outreach flow works: • Start with phone calls—the fastest way to reach busy owners—then follow up through WhatsApp or Instagram DMs and, when useful, email. • Open the conversation by mentioning the no-cost homepage mock-up. • Before you drop my calendar link, confirm three things: what the owner needs, when they hope to launch and their budget range. • As soon as a call is booked, log every detail—timestamp, contact info, notes—into our shared tracker the same day. You will never quote final prices or promise specific results such as Google rankings; my sales-training deck covers the exact talking points. Bilingual English-Spanish skill is strongly preferred, as many prospects switch languages mid-call. Prior success selling web-design or marketing services by cold outreach is essential, so please highlight that experience in your application. Deliverables I use to measure success: 1. Daily updated call log with notes in the tracker. 2. Calendar invites for each confirmed discovery call. If you can hit the phones confidently, keep meticulous records and switch between English and Spanish without missing a beat, I’m excited to work together.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Meta Ads para captar propietarios que quieren vender rápido en EE. UU.
opportunities.description: Somos una startup tecnológica del sector inmobiliario con sede en Florida. Buscamos un especialista freelance con amplia experiencia gestionando campañas de Facebook e Instagram para captar propietarios que necesitan vender su vivienda pronto. La campaña se enfocará en cuatro condados del Gran Atlanta, Georgia. Los anuncios dirigen a los propietarios a WhatsApp, donde nuestro bot responde y recoge los datos iniciales. Tu responsabilidad será gestionar las campañas y mejorar la cantidad y la calidad de las consultas que llegan a nuestro sistema. Qué harás - Revisar las campañas actuales y proponer un plan de mejora. - Configurar, gestionar y optimizar campañas de Meta Ads para los condados seleccionados. - Proponer y probar textos, imágenes y videos orientados a propietarios vendedores. - Reportar semanalmente la inversión, las conversaciones iniciadas en WhatsApp y el costo por propietario que comparte datos suficientes para evaluar una posible oferta de compra. Requisitos excluyentes - Hablar y escribir español con fluidez. - Residir actualmente en Estados Unidos o Centroamérica. - Tener experiencia comprobable gestionando personalmente campañas de Meta Ads para captar propietarios motivados a vender sus viviendas en Estados Unidos. - Conocer y aplicar las políticas publicitarias de Meta y las reglas aplicables a la publicidad inmobiliaria en Estados Unidos, incluidas las restricciones sobre segmentación, contenido de los anuncios y uso de datos. Se valora la experiencia adicional con Google Ads de Búsqueda para captar a este mismo tipo de propietario. Para postular, responde en español e incluye lo siguiente 1. Tu país de residencia actual. 2. Un caso real de una campaña que hayas gestionado para captar propietarios vendedores en EE. UU. Indica la zona, la duración, cuánto se invirtió en anuncios y qué parte gestionaste personalmente. 3. Cuántos propietarios calificados conseguiste y cómo definías que un contacto estaba calificado. Si puedes, comparte un reporte con los datos del cliente ocultos. 4. Qué revisarías primero en nuestra campaña y cuánto cobrarías por una prueba inicial. Comenzaremos con una prueba paga de alcance definido. Los honorarios y el presupuesto publicitario se acordarán por separado.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered LinkedIn Lead Generator
opportunities.description: I want to automate the way I discover brand-new prospects on LinkedIn. The system you build should scan LinkedIn profiles and company pages, identify people or organisations that match the criteria I will provide, and then capture their key contact data in a clean, export-ready format. Here is what success looks like for me: • The tool reliably pulls fresh, non-duplicate leads from LinkedIn at scale. • Each lead record includes name, role, company, location, and a working email or LinkedIn profile URL. • I can adjust search filters (industry, headcount, geography, keywords) without touching the code. • Results arrive in a spreadsheet or through an API endpoint so I can drop them straight into my CRM. • Everything runs autonomously once the parameters are set—no daily manual clicks required. You are free to choose the tech stack you’re most comfortable with—Python, JavaScript, browser automation, LinkedIn API, or an AI-driven scraping framework—as long as it respects LinkedIn’s terms of service and keeps my account safe. When you reply, please outline: 1. Your proposed approach to sourcing leads exclusively from LinkedIn. 2. The safeguards you’ll add to avoid bans or rate limits. 3. How quickly you can deliver a working prototype plus full documentation. I’m ready to move fast once we agree on the plan and timeline.

opportunities.title: Dynamics 365 CRM Systems Analyst
opportunities.description: Dynamics 365 CRM Systems Analyst Position Summary The CRM Systems Analyst is responsible for the administration, support, enhancement, and reporting of the organization's CRM platform. This role serves as the bridge between business users and technical teams, partnering across departments to ensure CRM data integrity, efficient business processes, meaningful reporting, reliable system integrations, and solutions that support organization -wide needs. The ideal candidate combines strong CRM administration skills with data management, reporting, and technical aptitude. They should be comfortable troubleshooting issues, working with APIs and integrations, building Power BI reports, collaborating with stakeholders across departments, and helping users maximize the value of business applications. While the role is currently focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, the successful candidate must be adaptable, curious, and willing to learn new technologies as organizational needs evolve, including the potential migration to a different CRM platform in the future. Key Responsibilities CRM Administration Administer, maintain, and optimize the organization's CRM platform and related business applications. Manage user accounts, security roles, permissions, and access requests. Configure forms, views, dashboards, workflows, and business process automations. Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate testing, deployment, and validation of system enhancements. Data Management & Quality Manage data imports, exports, cleansing, and deduplication efforts. Maintain data quality standards, integrity, and governance practices. Investigate and resolve data-related issues. Perform data audits and recommend process improvements. Document data structures, processes, and procedures. Reporting & Analytics Develop and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and data visualizations. Create recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders. Analyze CRM and operational data to identify trends and opportunities. Support leadership with meaningful metrics and performance reporting. Integrations & Technical Support Monitor and support integrations between CRM and other business systems. Assist in troubleshooting API, data synchronization, and automation issues. Work with software vendors, consultants, and developers to resolve technical challenges. Support Power Automate workflows and other low-code automation solutions. Assist with testing and validating integration changes. User Support & Training Serve as the primary point of contact for CRM user support. Investigate and resolve user issues and system requests. Develop documentation, training materials, and best practices. Conduct user training and onboarding sessions. Gather and prioritize enhancement requests from business stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve business processes through technology. Stay current with CRM, reporting, automation, and data management trends. Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and future platform evaluations. Assist with platform migrations and organizational technology initiatives as needed. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in information systems, Business, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years of experience administering a CRM or business application platform. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM systems. Experience creating reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar analytics tools. Understanding of data management, data quality, and reporting concepts. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and data exchange processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and customer service skills. Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new systems, technologies, and business applications. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. Experience with Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate. Knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts. Experience supporting cloud-based business applications. Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or related certifications. Experience working in a membership, association, nonprofit, or customerfocused environment. Desired Candidate Profile We are looking for a technically curious individual who enjoys learning new systems and solving business problems through technology. The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, supporting users while continuously improving processes, data quality, reporting, and system capabilities. Because CRM systems touch many areas of the organization, crossdepartmental collaboration is essential to understanding business needs, aligning solutions, and driving successful adoption. Success in this role requires adaptability and a willingness to learn. While the position is currently focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, we recognize that technology platforms evolve over time. The successful candidate will be excited to learn new applications, tools, and CRM platforms as organizational needs change and will play an active role in evaluating, implementing, and supporting future systems. We value problem-solving, initiative, and a growth mindset more than expertise in any single software platform. The ideal candidate sees technology skills as transferable and welcomes opportunities to expand their knowledge and contribute to organizational success regardless of the underlying platform. Success in This Role The successful candidate will: Maintain a reliable, secure, and well-governed CRM environment. Ensure high levels of data quality and user adoption. Deliver meaningful reporting and business insights through Power BI. Effectively support CRM users and business stakeholders. Help improve organizational efficiency through automation and process improvements. Adapt to evolving technologies and successfully support future platform changes and migrations. Estimated Role Focus: 40% CRM Administration & User Support 30% Data Management & Reporting 15% Process Improvement & Automation 15% Integrations & Technical Support This role is ideal for someone who is more technical than a traditional CRM administrator but less specialized than a software developer, with a strong interest in business systems, data, reporting, and continuous learning. ACSESS is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to creating a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination. Bachelor's (Required) Experience: Microsoft 365 Dynamics CRM: 3 years (Required) Protech Association Management Software (AMS): 2 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fitchburg, WI 53711

opportunities.description: Project Overview: Our storefront, product catalog, and WhatsApp sales integrations for Celvane are live and ready. We are looking for an experienced D2C Performance Marketer / E-Commerce Growth Specialist to drive ₹2,00,000 to ₹3,00,000 in gross sales during December 2026 through our upcoming Black Friday / Cyber Week Sale and Year-End Clearance Sale campaigns. Campaign Scope & Deliverables: 1. December Sale Funnel & Offer Execution: - Plan and execute high-converting ad campaigns for our December Sale events. - Set up and manage Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Sales/Conversion campaigns) alongside WhatsApp retargeting/broadcast flows to maximize checkout conversions. - Optimize ad creatives, hooks, and audience targeting to maintain a profitable Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). 2. opportunities.title: Detailed 3D Model of Prosthetic Leg
opportunities.description: I need a highly detailed 3D model of a human-style prosthetic leg, specifically designed for 3D printing a physical prototype. Requirements: - Realistic model that matches the existing structure. - Realistic 3D modeling of the images on the side to be 3D similar to the AI images shown. - Textures and markings to mimic a real wooden leg. - Output 3D printable STL files (2). Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in 3D modeling software (e.g., Blender, Maya, ZBrush). - Experience in creating intricate, realistic 3D models. - Familiarity with 3D printing requirements and constraints. NOTE: This model will be used to create a decorative outer shell of an existing prosthetic leg. Nothing in this design will be weight bearing. I can provide photos that can be used for photogrammetry for the basic shape of both parts (upper and lower leg). The inside of the leg is not important at the moment. The upper and lower ends can be closed off. The lower leg is supposed to represent a "griffin foot" atop a cannon ball. The cannon ball can be rough textured as if it is from the 19th century. The fur above the griffin foot needs to be better than the original.

opportunities.title: Redistribución Vivienda con Metrajes
opportunities.description: Quiero replantear por completo la distribución de mi vivienda y recibir planos acotados que muestren los metros exactos de cada pared. Necesito, al menos, dos propuestas distintas que incluyan dos baños, uno de ellos un baño completo con ducha. Prioridades clave • Aprovechar al máximo el espacio de almacenamiento, dando especial importancia a armarios amplios dentro de los dormitorios. • Mantener un flujo cómodo entre las zonas comunes sin sacrificar la capacidad de guardarropa. • Optimizar la ubicación de instalaciones para que la reforma sea viable técnica y económicamente. Entregables esperados 1. Plano actual digitalizado (si fuera necesario, puedo facilitar boceto y medidas básicas). 2. Dos o más opciones de nueva distribución en formato CAD o equivalente, cada una: – Acotada con metros lineales de todas las paredes. – Con indicación clara de los dos baños y sus piezas sanitarias. – Marcando la posición y tamaño de los armarios en dormitorios. 3. Breve memoria descriptiva que justifique las decisiones de diseño y las ventajas de cada opción. 4. Archivo editable (DWG, DXF o similar) y PDF listo para imprimir. Valoro que el profesional tenga experiencia en interiorismo residencial, manejo fluido de AutoCAD/Revit o herramienta similar y buen criterio para soluciones de almacenaje inteligentes. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y aportar planos, fotos o restricciones técnicas adicionales que faciliten el trabajo.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40832263, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 8 - 30.

opportunities.title: ArchiCAD CAD/BIM Drafter – Luxury Residential Interiors (Remote | Long-Term Contract)
opportunities.description: We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented ArchiCAD CAD/BIM Drafter to join our team on a remote, long-term contract basis. The ideal candidate has extensive experience producing accurate, comprehensive construction documentation for high-end residential interior design projects, with particular expertise in custom millwork and cabinetry. This role requires someone who can work independently, follow established drafting standards, and collaborate effectively with our interior design team. Key Responsibilities - Develop complete interior construction drawing sets in ArchiCAD based on designer plans, markups, and redlines. - Prepare detailed floor plans, reflected ceiling plans (RCPs), interior elevations, and sections. - Produce precise millwork, custom cabinetry, and built-in furniture drawings. - Work within our existing ArchiCAD templates while maintaining consistent drafting quality, organization, and file-naming conventions. - Incorporate design revisions accurately and efficiently. - Coordinate with the design team to ensure drawings meet project requirements and deadlines. Required Qualifications - Advanced proficiency in ArchiCAD, with senior-level drafting experience. - Must be able to work in ArchiCAD 25 Solo and have an active personal software license. - Proven experience preparing complete interior construction documentation, not just 3D models or renderings. - Strong knowledge of interior detailing, cabinetry, millwork, and residential construction methods. - Excellent attention to detail and ability to interpret design drawings and redlines. - Strong written English communication skills for daily collaboration. - Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines. - Availability of 30–40 hours per week, including some overlap with US Eastern Time. Preferred Qualifications - Previous experience working on luxury residential interior design projects. - Familiarity with US residential construction documentation, building practices, and drafting standards. - Experience collaborating remotely with interior designers and architects. Contract Details - Location: Fully Remote - Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Hourly) - Contract Duration: Initial 3 months, with strong potential for long-term collaboration - Workload: 30–40 hours per week - Hourly Rate: $4–$15 USD, based on skills and experience - Selection Process: Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid drafting trial. How to Apply - Please include the following in your application: - A brief introduction highlighting your ArchiCAD experience and relevant interior drafting projects. - A portfolio featuring complete interior construction drawing sets, including plans, elevations, sections, and millwork details. Applications featuring only renderings or 3D models will not be considered. - Confirmation that you have access to ArchiCAD 25 Solo and hold your own license. - Your proposed hourly rate and weekly availability. - Your experience working on US residential interior projects, if applicable. Important: To confirm that you have read the job description carefully, begin your proposal with the exact phrase "ArchiCAD Interior design". Applications without a relevant construction drawing portfolio will not be considered. We look forward to working with a reliable, experienced drafter who values precision, consistency, and high-quality interior construction documentation.

opportunities.title: AI Abattoir Management Automation
opportunities.description: AI GENERATION AI-Powered Abattoir Administration, Invoicing, Stock & Payment Management System Business: Buffalo Wings and Things Project: AI Generation Location: South Africa Preferred platform: n8n automation with a simple laptop-based management interface 1. Project Overview We want to develop an affordable, AI-powered administration system for our abattoir and meat sales business. The main objective is to automate invoicing, stock control, payment tracking and financial reporting while keeping the system simple enough for everyday use. The system must integrate WhatsApp communication with a central database that can be accessed and managed from a Windows laptop. 2. Stock and Inventory Management The system must include a stock management function directly linked to invoicing. Required functionality: * Stock will be entered manually using a laptop. * Each meat product must have its own stock balance, measured primarily in kilograms. * Products include rump, T-bone, biltong cuts, mince, boerewors, stew, shins and other meat products. * The user must be able to add new stock, adjust quantities and correct errors. * The system must automatically deduct the quantity sold from stock when an invoice is finalized. * Stock must not be deducted twice if an invoice is edited or processed again. * Cancelled or corrected invoices must update stock appropriately. * The system should display current stock balances and identify products running low. * Every stock movement must be recorded for traceability. Example: * Starting rump stock: 50 kg * Customer purchases: 8 kg * Invoice generated and finalized: 8 kg * Remaining rump stock: 42 kg The system must automatically update the available rump stock to 42 kg. 3. Automated Invoice Generation The system must generate professional PDF invoices for meat sales. Required functionality: * Receive completed order details through WhatsApp or manual entry. * Use AI to read photographs of handwritten order sheets. * Extract product descriptions, actual final weights and quantities. * Apply prices from an editable product price list. * Calculate invoice totals automatically. * Generate unique invoice reference numbers. * Include customer information, business details and banking details. * Produce a professional branded PDF invoice. * Allow the owner to review and approve invoices before sending them. * Link finalized invoices directly to stock deductions. 4. WhatsApp Integration The business currently uses a WhatsApp group containing the owner, his father and an abattoir worker. The system should work alongside this existing arrangement. Required functionality: * Receive completed meat order information. * Process typed messages and photographs of handwritten order sheets. * Prepare invoices based on the supplied information. * Use a dedicated WhatsApp Business number for AI Generation. * Receive customer proof-of-payment documents through WhatsApp. * Allow the owner to request invoice and payment reports through WhatsApp. The developer must confirm which parts of the existing WhatsApp group workflow can be integrated using supported WhatsApp Business APIs. 5. Payment Tracking and Proof of Payment The system must maintain an accurate record of outstanding customer payments. Required functionality: * Receive proof-of-payment documents. * Read payment amounts, dates and references. * Match payment proofs to existing invoices. * Identify fully paid, partially paid, unpaid and overdue invoices. * Calculate outstanding balances. * Allow manual confirmation of payments received in the FNB bank account. * Distinguish between proof of payment received and actual bank payment confirmed. * Generate reports of customers with outstanding balances. The system should not mark an invoice as paid solely because a customer submitted proof of payment. 6. Financial Reports and Administration The owner must be able to request simple reports, including: * Total sales for a selected day, week or month. * Total outstanding customer balances. * Paid and unpaid invoice lists. * Sales by meat product. * Current stock quantities. * Stock sold during a selected period. * Monthly invoicing and payment summaries. Example questions: “Show me all unpaid invoices.” “How many kilograms of rump do we have left?” “What was our total sales value this month?” “Show me all customers who still owe money.” 7. Laptop Management Interface The system must have a simple interface accessible from a Windows laptop. The user must be able to: * Manually capture new stock. * View and edit stock balances. * Maintain product prices. * Create and review invoices. * Search customer records. * View payment statuses. * Generate reports. The interface should be straightforward and require minimal technical knowledge. 8. Preferred Technology and Budget We prefer an affordable solution using: * n8n Community Edition for automation. * Google Sheets or a suitable database for initial recordkeeping. * AI document reading for handwritten orders and payment proofs. * PDF invoice generation. * Official WhatsApp Business integration. The system should be modular so that additional functionality can be introduced later. Budget preference: * Keep ongoing costs as close to R0 as reasonably possible. * Ideally remain below R300–R500 per month once fully operational. * Development costs should be quoted separately from monthly running costs. 9. Security, Ownership and Reliability * The business must own its database, customer information and workflows. * The owner must have full administrative access. * Customer and financial information must be protected. * The system must include regular backups. * Stock deductions and invoice updates must be reliable and auditable. * The developer must provide documentation and basic training. * The solution must account for South African data privacy requirements, including POPIA. 10. Expected Final Result We want a working AI-powered administration assistant that connects four essential business activities: STOCK → INVOICING → PAYMENTS → REPORTING The owner manually enters available stock on the laptop. When meat is sold, the system creates an invoice and automatically updates stock quantities. Customers submit payment proofs through WhatsApp, and the AI matches these to invoices. The owner can then monitor sales, inventory and outstanding customer payments from one central system. The objective is to reduce manual administration, prevent stock discrepancies, improve payment tracking and make the abattoir easier to manage as the business grows. Please provide a quotation for developing this system, including the estimated once-off development cost, monthly operating costs, implementation time and ongoing support.

opportunities.title: Program Arduino Stepper Automation
opportunities.description: I’m building a custom automated mechanism driven by an Arduino Uno and NEMA-series stepper motors—the motion hardware is already selected and wired up, much like a stripped-down 3D-printer axis. What I still need is a clean, reliable sketch that will run the show. Your main task is to write the Arduino code that orchestrates the steppers, limit switches, and a simple control panel (start/stop buttons plus a status LED). The motion routine is not a standard “print” or “pick-and-place” cycle; it follows a sequence I will share in detail once we get started, but think of it as a repeatable multi-position move with dwell times and homing on power-up. Because the mechanism borrows components from the 3D-printing world, familiarity with libraries such as AccelStepper, GRBL-style movement, or Marlin-style homing logic will be useful. The mechanical side, wiring, and driver selection are covered—I just need tight, well-commented firmware that: • Homes safely on both axes using limit switches • Executes the positional routine from a single button press • Allows easy tweaking of speeds, micro-steps, and dwell delays • Handles basic fault conditions (stall, missed step, emergency stop) Please deliver the fully documented .ino file along with any additional header libraries or pin-mapping notes so I can flash and test immediately. If you can suggest improvements to motion smoothness or code efficiency, that’s a plus. Let me know your turnaround and any clarifying questions, and we’ll get this machine moving.

opportunities.title: Riyadh Retail AI Automation Report
opportunities.description: I need a concise yet actionable report that shows retail and e-commerce companies in Riyadh exactly how artificial intelligence and automation can replace labour-intensive processes and cut operating costs. The focus is strictly on this industry; I’m not looking for coverage of government services or other private-sector segments. The document should move from problem identification to concrete, data-backed solutions. Map the current retail and e-commerce workflow in Riyadh, pinpoint high-friction manual tasks (stock reconciliation, order routing, customer service, pricing updates, etc.) and recommend the best-fit AI tools—think RPA bots, computer-vision shelf scanning, conversational AI, demand-forecasting engines—along with projected savings and an implementation timeline. Deliverables: • 15-20 page PDF report formatted for executive review • Process maps highlighting manual vs. automated steps • Cost–benefit analysis with local salary and tech pricing assumptions • Roadmap with quick wins (≤3 months) and longer-term roll-outs (up to 18 months) • Brief appendix listing Riyadh-based vendors, regulations, and relevant case studies Acceptance criteria: each recommendation must state estimated hours saved per month and expected ROI within the first year. If you have experience drafting similar automation assessments for retail or e-commerce, especially in GCC markets, I’d love to see a sample outline or excerpt when you bid.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40832091, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

opportunities.title: AI Voice Sales Agent Automation
opportunities.description: I want to launch an AI-driven voice agent that can handle both inbound and outbound sales calls from start to finish. Its core job is to qualify every caller, following a scripted set of questions that uncover their needs, budget, and decision timeline. As it speaks, the agent must capture the prospect’s name, phone, email, and company details, then push that data directly into my CRM. When the lead meets the preset criteria, the agent should automatically book a time on my sales team’s calendar and send the prospect a confirmation email or SMS. Key deliverables • Production-ready voice agent capable of natural, human-like conversations • Workflow to ask qualifying questions, collect contact details, and schedule meetings • Real-time CRM integration and calendar booking automation • Dashboard or logs so I can review call recordings, transcripts, and lead data • Clear hand-off logic for calls the bot cannot handle Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining your technical approach, tools or APIs you intend to use (e.g., Twilio, Dialogflow, Azure, Amazon Connect, GPT, or similar), timeline, and any previous examples of live voice-automation you have built. I’ll use that proposal to assess fit and move quickly into implementation.

opportunities.title: Remote Retail Tech Project Coordinator
opportunities.description: Job Description: Project Coordinator and Personal Assistant (Part-Time Role) Position Type: Part-Time (hourly), freelance Location: Remote (working from home, accommodating US hours as needed) About Us We are a retail tech community and innovation hub connecting startups, retailers, brands, and innovators. Founded in 2013, we run research and industry reports, host events including create opportunities for collaboration across the global retail-tech ecosystem. We are seeking an organized and proactive Project Manager and Personal Assistant to oversee projects, manage operations, and ensure seamless coordination with our partners in Israel and the US. This is a part-time (50%) role, ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment and can work effectively across time zones. Key Responsibilities Project Management Oversee ongoing projects, including events, research, workshops, and collaborations with local and global partners. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule and to a high standard. Manage schedules, timelines, and resources for multiple projects simultaneously. Create and oversee grant applications, proposals, and other project-related documentation. Operational Management & Personal Assistant Manage the day-to-day operations of the company, ensuring smooth workflows and efficient processes. Book meetings, organize schedules, and manage client and partner communications. Write project proposals and reports, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Support inbox management, meeting notes and summaries, follow-ups, travel arrangements, and other personal assignments as needed. Marketing, Events & Community Manage the marketing activities of the company, either directly or via subcontractors working with the company. Define targets and KPIs for the marketing activity and make sure they are met. Manage the company's websites and other digital assets. Create and send a monthly or bi-monthly newsletter as needed. Manage the promotion calendar, which includes channels such as social media, WhatsApp groups, blog etc. Manage the marketing and promotion of events. Help with event production, content, and sponsorship sales. Research potential new leads and manage ongoing outreach to build sales opportunities. Build a community management strategy and execute it, either directly or via subcontractors working with the company. Requirements Highly Organized: Exceptional multitasker with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage tasks and people who don't directly report to you. Digital Proficiency: Comfortable using tools like HubSpot, WordPress, Canva, and Google Workspace, and fluent with AI tools (meeting assistants, LLMs) for drafting, research and follow-ups. Experience with other SaaS tools is a plus. People-Oriented: A natural relationship builder who enjoys engaging with clients, partners, and team members. Proactive Problem-Solver: Self-motivated and resourceful, with the ability to identify challenges and find solutions independently. Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, Hebrew is an advantage. Flexible: Willing to work US hours as needed. Bonus Skills Experience in sales development or leading sales processes. Interest and knowledge of the tech or retail industries. Details Role Type: Part-time, ~20 hours per week. Work Environment: Fully remote, working US hours as needed. Reporting to: CEO Selection process: 1.Assessment 2.Interview

opportunities.title: Complete Flat Interior Design
opportunities.description: I’m ready to give my entire flat a cohesive, professional look and need a designer who can take the project from concept to final visuals. Every space is on the table—living room, all bedrooms, kitchen, bathrooms, balcony, and the entry area—so the plan must flow naturally from one room to the next. For the bedrooms I lean toward a modern, simple aesthetic: clean lines, light tones, and practical storage that keeps clutter out of sight. I’m open to complementary moods for the remaining areas as long as the overall palette and materials feel consistent and contemporary. You’re free to use the tools you’re most comfortable with—AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit, or similar—as long as the deliverables arrive in a format I can review easily. Deliverables I expect • Mood boards and color/material palettes for each room • Scaled floor plans with furniture layout • 3D renders or walkthroughs that clearly convey the design intent • A concise shopping/specification list covering key finishes, lighting, and furniture pieces I’ll provide current floor plans and measurements once we start; you’ll guide me on any additional details you need. I value clear communication and phased checkpoints so adjustments can happen early rather than late. If this sounds like your kind of project, let’s talk timelines and get started.

opportunities.title: Design 3D Print-Ready Model
opportunities.description: I need a detailed 3D model prepared specifically for 3D printing. Once finished, the file should be ready to slice with no additional cleanup or repairs on my end—think watertight geometry, correct wall thickness, and properly oriented normals. Because I haven’t attached photos, sketches, or measurements yet, I’ll provide you with all the reference material and dimensions as soon as we connect. From there, you can recommend the best CAD workflow (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Blender, or any package you’re comfortable with) and flag any design constraints that could affect printability. Deliverables • Print-ready STL (or OBJ if preferred) • Original editable file from your software of choice I’ll review the model by test-slicing it in Cura; if it slices cleanly without errors and the dimensions match the spec sheet, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: Zen Meditation Corner Design
opportunities.description: I need a thoughtful Zen-style plan for one specific area—my small courtyard—which I want to turn into a quiet space for relaxing and meditation. The footprint is modest, so every stone, plant, and water element has to earn its place and work together to create flow, balance, and a sense of calm. The job is design-only (no installation), but I do need it fast. If we can move from concept to final drawings within the next few days, that would be ideal. Deliverables • Scaled layout showing hardscape, planting zones, and focal points • Plant and material palette with local sourcing notes • Simple 3D or isometric visual to illustrate atmosphere • Brief maintenance notes so I can keep the space looking pristine All files should be delivered in PDF and an editable format (DWG, SketchUp, or similar).

opportunities.title: Agente Telefónico Hostel Online
opportunities.description: Necesito a alguien que atienda todas las llamadas de mi hostel online. Las conversaciones serán exclusivamente en español y, en su mayoría, giran en torno a consultas sobre disponibilidad y precios de las habitaciones. Lo que espero de tu trabajo: • Contestar cada llamada dentro del horario acordado, con un tono cordial y profesional. • Verificar disponibilidad y tarifas en nuestro motor de reservas antes de dar una respuesta. • Registrar en una hoja de seguimiento el nombre del interesado, fechas solicitadas y el resultado de la conversación. • Escalar al correo interno cualquier solicitud especial o incidencia que no puedas resolver en el momento. Requisitos mínimos: • Español nativo y excelente presencia telefónica. • Conexión a internet estable y micrófono de buena calidad. • Experiencia previa en atención hotelera, call centers o reservas online. • Manejo fluido de herramientas VoIP (CloudTalk, Aircall o similares). Proporciono manual de preguntas frecuentes, acceso a la línea VoIP y credenciales del PMS. Empezaremos con un turno de prueba de una semana; si todo marcha bien, la colaboración será a largo plazo. Indícame tu disponibilidad horaria y cualquier experiencia relevante cuando envíes tu propuesta.

opportunities.title: FlutterFlow MVP para Viajeros
opportunities.description: Necesito un MVP completamente funcional en FlutterFlow para una app dirigida a quienes visitan Costa Rica. El prototipo debe estar listo lo antes posible. La app combina tres pilares: permite planificar itinerarios y rutas personalizados, facilita la búsqueda y reserva de tours, actividades y alojamientos, y ofrece recomendaciones locales confiables sobre transporte, gastronomía y puntos de interés. Quiero que todo esto conviva en un flujo limpio, en español e inglés, y con una interfaz que pueda refinarse rápidamente a partir de feedback real de usuarios. Entrego la arquitectura de contenidos, algunos wireframes y la paleta de colores; tú te encargas de montarlo en FlutterFlow, conectar los datos con Firestore (o la opción que sugieras) y dejar configuradas las principales pantallas: onboarding, exploración con filtros, itinerario interactivo, ficha de proveedor y pasarela de reserva (mock o sandbox, según el tiempo). Por favor incluye: • Un enlace al proyecto en FlutterFlow para poder iterar juntos • Acceso de tipo “viewer” para mi equipo • Instrucciones breves de despliegue en Android e iOS (builds de prueba) Valoro experiencia previa con FlutterFlow, Firebase/Firestore y diseño orientado a viajeros. Si puedes empezar de inmediato y entregarme la primera versión en cuestión de días, házmelo saber en tu propuesta junto con un par de ejemplos de trabajos similares.

Quiero que todo esto conviva en un flujo limpio, en español e inglés, y con una interfaz que pueda refinarse rápidamente a partir de feedback real de usuarios. Entrego la arquitectura de contenidos, algunos wireframes y la paleta de colores; tú te encargas de montarlo en FlutterFlow, conectar los datos con Firestore (o la opción que sugieras) y dejar configuradas las principales pantallas: onboarding, exploración con filtros, itinerario interactivo, ficha de proveedor y pasarela de reserva (mock o sandbox, según el tiempo). Por favor incluye: • Un enlace al proyecto en FlutterFlow para poder iterar juntos • Acceso de tipo “viewer” para mi equipo • Instrucciones breves de despliegue en Android e iOS (builds de prueba) Valoro experiencia previa con FlutterFlow, Firebase/Firestore y diseño orientado a viajeros. Si puedes empezar de inmediato y entregarme la primera versión en cuestión de días, házmelo saber en tu propuesta junto con un par de ejemplos de trabajos similares."

opportunities.title: Development of an AI Agent for E-Commerce Order Processing
opportunities.description: I am seeking a skilled freelancer to assist in creating an advanced AI voice agent to enhance the customer experience in order processing for my business. This project aims to integrate AI-driven solutions for seamless operations. Key Requirements: - Develop an AI agent capable of processing orders with precision and efficiency. - Ensure integration with existing applications to streamline workflows. - Maintain a user-friendly and intuitive interface for customer interactions. Expected agent features: - Accurately collect order details, including products, quantities, shipping, and payment. - Provide clear and helpful instructions to guide customers through the process. - Suggest additional relevant products and apply discounts appropriately. - Handle special requests and provide comprehensive order confirmations. AI Agent Prompt: You are an AI specialist in order processing designed to create seamless shopping experiences. Instructions: 1) Guide customers through order processing with clear instructions. 2) Collect accurate information (products, quantities, shipping, and payment). 3) Confirm order details before completion to avoid errors. 4) Suggest additional relevant products and apply available discounts. 5) Clearly explain shipping options and return policies. 6) Handle special requests efficiently. 7) Provide confirmations for completed orders while maintaining a friendly attitude.
